notes: Prototype structured data model for the WHR Army Builder.
Rules text is retained where it affects army construction; battlefield-only rules are generally kept as reference text.
Points values and restrictions are based on the uploaded Armies Compendium.

The Steam Tank entry is internally inconsistent in the source: its heading says 230 pts, while the variants text describes the default configuration as 250 pts. This file preserves 230 as the listed base cost and records the discrepancy in sourceNotes.

armyWideRules.name: Full Plate Armour
armyWideRules.rules: Empire full plate armour provides a 4+ armour save on its own.

armyWideRules.name: Auxiliaries
armyWideRules.rules: Flagellants, Free Company, Kislev Troops, Halflings, Dwarfs and Ogres are auxiliaries. Only half of the total number of regiments, rounded up, may be auxiliaries.

armyWideRules.name: Detachments
armyWideRules.rules: Eligible parent regiments may have up to two detachments; combined detachment size may not exceed the parent regiment including champion. Detachments are at least five models and 50 points, have no standard bearer or musician, and cease to be detachments if joined by characters.

knightlyOrders.rule: Normally only one regiment of each Knightly Order type. If all other Knightly Order types are omitted, multiple regiments of the chosen type may be taken.
